negative_reviews.author: Bridget Blasdell
negative_reviews.text:
This place was ok. The menus could have done with a wipe down. They were sticky. They are also big and bulky, especially the drinks menu.
We were a table of 5 and wished to sit outside due to the lovely weather. The host was unsure as "the tables can't be moved" and made up for 2 or 4. We suggested to split and sit as a 2 and 3, not ideal as we are 2 adults and 3 children. We ended up with a chair at the end of our table but it blocked access to the table next to us.

It was suggested we use the QR to order or pay upfront with the server. We opted to order via the QR, however you you can't order the kids bento on there. So we ended up doing that with the server. All a big fluff to be honest. Sorry we removed the pre added service charge when ordering because why pay service upfront? The staff were nice but this cost them a tip, as we didn't have cash to leave one.
Food was ok, half of us enjoyed it and half didn't. We all had
the same fried chicken but in different dishes.

The deco' is lovely but could have done without the faux blossom flowers on the outside as they block the view of the lake.

Those little things could make this place great. We will try again some time.

negative_reviews.author: jel Yuen
negative_reviews.text:
Starter was a 10/10
Main was a 7/10
Drinks 7/10

Service was below par
And atmosphere was low

Come here if you really want Ramen.

negative_reviews.author: Olivia Sharp
negative_reviews.text: ordered off of the £18 lunch deal, me and my friend both got gyozas and sushi & a bubble tea. got told after we ordered that the bubble tea isnt included in thr lunch menu and that we had to pay an extra £2 each for it - the menu doesnt say this. food was very mediocre, i liked the gyozas but they were clearly very cheap, the sushi tasted identical to the pre-packaged lunch deal you get from tesco. wont visit again.
